comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Culture and Engagement Survey Results
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD conducts annual global workforce surveys to measure culture and engagement; the 2024 survey results were among the best for global tech companies, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative and engagement ratings in the top 10% of peers.
comparisons.comparison: While Intel defines its strategy through the broad lens of attracting, developing, and retaining talent to create global impact, AMD provides specific evidence of the 'retaining' and 'culture' aspect of that strategy through its engagement survey results. Intel states its people 'build our technology... and create global impact,' whereas AMD reports that its 2024 survey results were among the best in the industry, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative, and engagement in the top 10% of peers, validating the success of its talent environment.

sentences.text: Together we strive to have a positive effect on business, society, and the planet.
Our people build our technology, unlock new business opportunities, and work with our partners and customers to create global impact.
Results from our 2024 survey reported scores that continued to be among the very best for global companies in the technology industry.

Our employees described our culture as inclusive, innovative, open, and respectful, and rated the quality of our managers high, and employment engagement is among the top 10% of our high-performing technology industry peers.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company partners with educational institutions and governments to expand the pipeline of diverse STEM talent and focuses on merit-based hiring, while committing to developing team members through training, mentoring, and leadership development programs.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron frame the attraction and development of top talent as central to their strategic execution. Intel states that delivering on its strategy requires attracting, developing, and retaining top talent from across the world, who build technology and create global impact. Similarly, Micron describes finding and retaining the best and brightest people as a 'strategic imperative' and outlines specific mechanisms for this, such as partnering with educational institutions to expand the STEM talent pipeline and committing to developing team members through training and mentoring.

sentences.text: Delivering on our strategy and growth ambitions requires attracting, developing, and retaining top talent from across the world.
Our people build our technology, unlock new business opportunities, and work with our partners and customers to create global impact.
Finding and retaining the best and brightest people in an extremely competitive industry environment is a strategic imperative for our business.

We are committed to developing team members at all stages of their careers, including on-the-job training, continuing education, a robust mentoring program, and numerous internal certifications and training.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA has grown its technical workforce and successfully attracted top talent globally, with 83% of employees in technical roles and 49% holding advanced degrees.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA highlight the competitive global nature of attracting top technical talent as a key component of their workforce strategy. Intel asserts that delivering on its strategy requires attracting 'top talent from across the world.' NVIDIA mirrors this by noting that global technical talent demand is competitive and that it has been successful in 'attracting top talent to NVIDIA,' resulting in a workforce that is 83% technical with 49% holding advanced degrees.

sentences.text: Delivering on our strategy and growth ambitions requires attracting, developing, and retaining top talent from across the world.
As the demand for global technical talent continues to be competitive, we have grown our technical workforce and have been successful in attracting top talent to NVIDIA.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company invests in talent development through training opportunities, rotational assignments, performance management methodologies, global workshops, and personalized online learning resources to help employees achieve career goals.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies explicitly link talent development to maintaining technological leadership. Intel identifies 'developing' top talent as a requirement for delivering on its strategy and building technology. Qualcomm similarly states it invests significant resources to 'develop the talent needed to remain a world-leading innovator,' detailing specific development tools like training opportunities, rotational assignments, and global workshops to help employees achieve career goals.

sentences.text: Delivering on our strategy and growth ambitions requires attracting, developing, and retaining top talent from across the world.
We invest significant resources to develop the talent needed to remain a world-leading innovator in wireless technologies and high-performance and low-power computing, including AI.

We deliver numerous training opportunities, provide rotational assignment opportunities, focus on continuous learning and development and have implemented what we believe are industry-leading methodologies to manage performance, provide feedback and develop talent.
